content: Bepaŋ, du siloŋ tobogoŋ tiŋa kahaŋ tinimbeŋ. Du diweune foune nibuŋa momooŋ tinimbeŋ.
Unduŋ tubune metam hogohogok adi titiŋge u kaŋ nadiŋa du kubugoŋdi kotigoŋ kedem yanagilaaŋ unduŋ u kedem nadineŋ.
Bepaŋ, nu adi metam hogohogokdi dutok nadifo tiŋa wohoge ganintiloneŋdok nadilat. Biyagoŋ, kwetkwet hatitawiiŋ hogohogok wanakaŋ hinek ganiutumbaneŋ.

Du titiŋ didimeniŋ tiŋa mede yodapmaŋ kwanai tilaŋ, tiŋa undugoŋ da kubugoŋdi metam yabu-ulidokoune talik momooŋ takaliiŋ. Wendoktiŋa metam hogohogok adi welemomooŋ nadiŋa kap toŋa nadifo kedem tineŋ.
Bepaŋ, nu adi metam hogohogokdi dutok nadifo tiŋa wohoge ganintiloneŋdok nadilat. Biyagoŋ, kwetkwet hatitawiiŋ hogohogok wanakaŋ hinek ganiutumbaneŋ.
Bepaŋ adi indi’walaŋ Bepaŋnik, unduŋ doktiŋa kahaŋ tinimguk. Kaŋ kwetnineŋ duhuduhu momooŋ mintanimilak.
Biyagoŋ hinek, Bepaŋdi nihikahaŋnegukdi nihikahaŋnelak, wendoktiŋa metam kwetkwet hatiiŋ hogohogokdi aditok gikiŋgoŋ timiyaneeŋ.
